channel.title: Journal Publications | KSHITIJ KUMAR
channel.description: Peer-reviewed journal publications, preprints, and manuscripts in neural engineering, systems electrophysiology, and computational cognition by Kshitij Kumar.

item.title: A Translational Platform for Polyimide Neural Interfaces: Polyimide Synthesis and In Vivo Evaluation in Epileptic Mice
item.description: Development of clinical-grade BPDA–pPDA polyimide-based flexible microelectrode arrays for in vivo electrophysiology recording, with translational applications in brain-computer interfaces. Published in IEEE Access.

item.title: State-dependent aperiodic EEG dynamics track cortical network reorganization in chronic epilepsy
item.description: Evaluating 1/f aperiodic EEG spectral slope as a systems-level electrophysiological marker of cortical excitation-inhibition (E/I) balance in chronic epilepsy models. Under review at PNAS Nexus.

item.title: Schizotypal Traits and Belief Updating in Dynamic Environments: Insights from a Novel Patch-Foraging Paradigm
item.description: Investigating heterogeneity in belief updating, environmental volatility priors, and adaptive exploration-exploitation trade-offs across schizotypal personality traits using a computational patch-foraging framework. Submitted to PLOS ONE.

item.title: A Tutorial on Interpreting Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy of Neural Microelectrodes
item.description: A comprehensive methodological and theoretical tutorial for neural engineering researchers on measurement, equivalent circuit modeling, and physical interpretation of electrical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) across neural microelectrodes. Under review at Frontiers in Neuroscience.

item.title: Learning and Decision Making in Dynamic Environments
item.description: Investigating how humans arbitrate between working memory representations and reinforcement learning in non-stationary, depleting foraging landscapes under varying cognitive constraints. Manuscript Ready for Submission.

item.title: Synergistic effects of glucocorticoid and noradrenergic activity on spatial memory
item.description: Evaluating the combined neuromodulatory actions of corticosteroid elevation and noradrenergic stimulation on rodent spatial memory encoding, retrieval, and hippocampal-prefrontal circuit dynamics. Manuscript Ready for Submission.

item.title: A Novel Commutable Coaxial Micro-Macro Electrode for MER in Human DBS: Preclinical Rodent Evaluation
item.description: Design, fabrication, and preclinical validation of a unified commutable coaxial electrode architecture enabling microelectrode recording (MER) and therapeutic macro-stimulation without surgical lead exchange in deep brain stimulation. Manuscript Under Preparation.

item.title: Biomarker discovery using machine learning in the psychosis spectrum
item.description: Machine learning approaches for biomarker discovery across the psychosis spectrum, encompassing schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorders, bipolar disorder with psychosis, and clinical high risk for psychosis. Published in Biomarkers in Neuropsychiatry, Elsevier.
